description: Defines the class 'ru_lower_phy_error_adapter' which implements error notification handling for lower PHY errors in a radio communication system, including methods for late resource grid, PRACH request issues, and uplink request late events.

classes.name: ru_lower_phy_error_adapter
classes.description: Implements error notification callbacks for lower PHY errors, such as late resource grid, PRACH request issues, and uplink request late events, interfacing with logger and error notifier.

methods.name: on_late_resource_grid
methods.description: Handles late resource grid events, logs warning, notifies error, and traces event.

methods.name: on_prach_request_late
methods.description: Handles late PRACH request events, logs warning, and traces event.

methods.name: on_prach_request_overflow
methods.description: Handles overflow in PRACH request, logs warning, and traces event.

methods.name: on_puxch_request_late
methods.description: Handles late PUCCH request, logs warning, notifies error, and traces event.
